## Notation quick reference {#sec-notation}

This project maintains a full, growing symbol table across all eight
workbooks; later chapters introduce mechanisms this pilot doesn't cover
(KV-cache size, expert counts, and others start in Chapter 3 onward).
The subset below is everything Chapters 1-2 actually use -- flip back
here if a symbol in an equation isn't immediately obvious.

| Symbol | Name | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| $B$ | batch size | number of independent sequences processed together |
| $S$ | sequence length | number of tokens in the current sequence |
| $V$ | vocabulary size | number of distinct token ids; also the output-head's logit width |
| $d_{\text{model}}$ | hidden dimension | width of the residual stream, constant across every block |
| $H_q$ | query heads | number of attention query heads (the "q" matters starting Chapter 3) |
| $d_{\text{head}}$ | head dimension | width of one attention head, $d_{\text{model}} / H_q$ |
| $L$ | number of layers | count of decoder blocks stacked |
| $d_{\text{ff}}$ | feed-forward expansion dimension | width of a feed-forward sublayer's hidden projection |

: Notation used in Chapters 1-2 only; later chapters extend this table {#tbl-notation}
